snippet.title: Decision: Medieval Flash Game Trailer
snippet.description:
★ We are happy to announce the return of the legendary Decision Flash-game series! Now you are able to play all four games again in the Decision Legacy Collection.
➤ Play now https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015510/Decision_Legacy_Collection/

★ DONATE: You can help make a New Decision: Medieval. FlyAnvil team would love your support!
➤ Subscribe to our Boosty Found https://boosty.to/flyanvil

★ The new Decision: Red Daze available now on Steam : https://bit.ly/yt_DecisionRedDaze and GOG.com : https://bit.ly/ytg-DecisionRedDaze
Stay tuned https://twitter.com/DecisionRedDaze

Lead your kingdom to victory against hordes of zombies, orcs, werewolves and trolls in this Middle Ages sequel of "Decision" series. And now we are making Decision: Red Daze! Follow the news! 
http://flyanvil.com/
